privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states customer data 'will not be used for developing, improving, or training third party AI and/or ML models'; they reserve the right to use only de-identified, aggregated, non-personal data. A 'No Model Training' feature ensures team data is not used to train/improve models, and Zero Data Retention (ZDR) can be enabled on Team/Enterprise plans and for API use so inputs/outputs are not retained (metadata with anonymous identifiers and trust-and-safety data may still be kept). Google Cloud Platform is listed as an LLM subprocessor 'with Zero Data Retention and Zero Data Training'.
privacy.data_region: Primarily US (AWS and Google Cloud Platform subprocessors hosted in the United States). Data may be transferred out of the user's country of residence; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework participant.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Third-party penetration tests / assessments performed and published in trust center (e.g. 'Su-Sea Sep 2025 Mobile Assessment', 'Su-Sea Sep 2025 API Assessment Report'). 'Penetration testing performed' listed as a product security control.

security.name: Bug bounty / VDP
security.value: No public HackerOne or Bugcrowd bug bounty program found. Security contact published as security@you.com. Relies on third-party pentests rather than a public crowdsourced program.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: TLS in transit ('All our communications and websites are encrypted using transport layer security'); 'Data encryption utilized' and 'Encryption key access restricted' listed as controls. Portable media encrypted.

security.name: Zero Data Retention
security.value: Optional ZDR: 'All queries and data can be automatically purged' giving customers control over what is stored and for how long; ZDR available on Team/Enterprise plans and API.

security.name: Access control & infrastructure
security.value: Unique production database authentication enforced, unique account authentication enforced, asset disposal procedures, production inventory maintained; documented Access Control, Asset Management, and Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery policies.

security.name: Incident response
security.value: Documented Incident Response Plan with a GDPR addendum and breach notification procedures published in the trust center.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Disclosed subprocessors include AWS (US hosting), Google Cloud Platform (US, LLM provider with ZDR/Zero Data Training), Cloudflare (CDN/DNS/abuse prevention), Osano (privacy ops), Baseten (added Apr 2026).

products.name: Search API
products.category: Web search API for AI agents/LLMs
products.data_scope: Real-time web search results; queries can be purged via ZDR; not used to train third-party models.
products.notes: Marketed as enterprise-grade with custom QPS limits and DPA-ready.

products.name: Contents API
products.data_scope: Fetches/cleans page content from supplied URLs; same ZDR and no-training posture as Search API.
products.notes: Returns full page content in chosen formats (HTML, etc.).

products.name: Research API
products.data_scope: Generates cited, grounded answers; inputs/outputs subject to ZDR option.

products.name: Finance Research API
products.data_scope: Domain-specific financial research over web data; same data-handling controls.
products.notes: Newer product, ranked #1 on FinSearchComp per vendor.

products.name: you.com Assistant (consumer / Team / Enterprise)
products.category: Consumer and team AI assistant / search chat
products.data_scope: Consumer free tier collects usage data and may fund services via ads; Team/Enterprise plans add 'No Model Training' and optional Zero Data Retention with DPA and tighter controls.
products.notes: Data/compliance scope is stronger on Team/Enterprise than on the consumer free tier.

compare.pricing_model: Free API trial plus usage-based paid API tiers; consumer free tier and paid Team/Enterprise plans (MSA + DPA for enterprise).
compare.data_residency: US-based (AWS + GCP, United States); cross-border transfers possible; EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework participant.

flags: ZDR and No Model Training are opt-in / plan-dependent (Team/Enterprise/API), not the default for the consumer free tier, which also uses data for ads and product analytics.
